pages.text: Look for bright berries on a two-section stalk in plains, forests, hills or cold Overworld biomes. Village greenhouses and crop trades can also supply cherries. The cherries themselves are planting stock.

pages.title: Picking Cherries
pages.text: Plant cherries on farmland, dirt or grass in a bright area. Leave space for the upper section and break berry-laden sections. The upper section has fewer growth stages. Keep some cherries for planting.
Roast the rest in a regular furnace. See $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/coffee)making a cup$(/l).
